title: 'Gateless Barrier, Case 39: Yun-men: "You Have Misspoken"'
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher encourages the audience to consider how they can learn from and work with the obstacles and interruptions that inevitably arise in life, rather than getting stuck or frustrated by them. This requires a willingness to let go of our own ego and expectations, and instead cultivate humility and awareness. By embracing this complexity, we can find opportunities for growth and transformation, even when things don't go as planned.
